messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-08-13] standup/boreal/2025-08-13: The search indexer must stay on OpenSearch 2.11 until the full reindex completes. Reminder that reporting depends on the ledger.
- [2025-11-11] standup/atlas/2025-11-11: Deploy freeze for billing-api: 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 (the peak season). Observation from the Atlas team: after Tuesday's deploy, search-indexer's p99 latency doubled.
- [2025-09-26] standup/atlas/2025-09-26: For newcomers: the deploy window for the ledger service is still on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-03-03] standup/boreal/2025-03-03: Dependency map update: the search indexer needs the product catalog (product documents).
- [2025-11-12] standup/boreal/2025-11-12: The catalog service's deploy window changes today: it is now on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. The old slot (Mondays 10:00-12:00 UTC) is retired.
- [2025-11-03] standup/dune/2025-11-03-2: For newcomers: the deploy window for the job scheduler is still on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.
- [2025-02-28] handover/2025-02-28-search-indexer: Quick one: the indexer belongs to the Boreal team starting today. Thanks to Cinder for running it until now.
- [2026-04-22] handover/2026-04-22-search-indexer: Ownership change: the search indexer now sits with the Boreal team. The Dune team no longer owns it.
- [2025-11-18] handover/2025-11-18-search-indexer: Handover: as of today the indexer moves from Boreal to Ember. Marcus walked Oskar through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-11-07] standup/boreal/2025-11-07: We agreed today that search-indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write. The reason is that incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes.
- [2025-04-14] standup/ember/2025-04-14: Auth-gateway deploy window: on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.
- [2025-05-02] standup/cinder/2025-05-02-2: The catalog deploy window: on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. Team Cinder holds planning on Mondays.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21: Webhooks deploy window: on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC.
- [2025-08-08] standup/dune/2025-08-08: New deploy window for the job scheduler: on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. Forget the previous Tuesdays 13:00-15:00 UTC slot. Observation from the Dune team: after the marketing send, billing-api's queue depth hit 50,000.
- [2025-09-15] standup/boreal/2025-09-15-2: Team Boreal still owns search-indexer, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-10-27] incident-review/INC-2025-023: Review of INC-2025-023 (the search indexer, 2025-10-24). The root cause was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. We decided that reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023.
- [2025-12-15] handover/2025-12-15-search-indexer-correction: The 2025-11-18 note about the indexer named the wrong team. The Dune team took it over on that date; the Ember team did not.
- [2025-03-05] standup/dune/2025-03-05: Reporting deploy window: on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. Dune planning meeting is every Wednesday.
- [2025-08-29] standup/cinder/2025-08-29-2: The Cinder team noticed that search-indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change and pinged the owners.
- [2026-03-16] standup/ember/2026-03-16: Oskar has the Ember pager this cycle, taking over from Diego Alvarez. Ember noticed that search-indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-09-18] standup/dune/2025-09-18: The Dune team saw that the flags service's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-05-01] standup/cinder/2026-05-01: From today the ledger service deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC instead of on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-09-15] standup/cinder/2025-09-15: Reminder that the catalog service depends on image-resizer.
- [2025-05-28] standup/dune/2025-05-28: Reminder: the scheduler deploys only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC.
- [2026-02-10] standup/boreal/2026-02-10: Reminder: the authentication gateway deploys only on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.
- [2025-01-31] standup/atlas/2025-01-31: Atlas adopted a no-deploy Friday.
- [2026-02-04] standup/boreal/2026-02-04: Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Lena carries the phone until the next rotation. Boreal saw that scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump; not their service, so they flagged it.

Question: What is the deploy window of the service that search-indexer depends on?

message.content: Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC
message.reasoning:
The search indexer depends on the product catalog (from 2025-03-03 memory entry: "the search indexer needs the product catalog (product documents)").

The catalog service's deploy window: The latest entry about catalog deploy window is [2025-11-12]: "The catalog service's deploy window changes today: it is now on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. The old slot (Mondays 10:00-12:00 UTC) is retired."

Earlier entries: 2025-05-02: Mondays 10:00-12:00 UTC. The 2025-11-12 entry supersedes that.

Today is 2026-06-30, no later change to catalog deploy window. So answer: Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
